user.title: Connect to MySOLEM
user.description: Enter the credentials of your MySOLEM account (the same ones you use on mysolem.com).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MySOLEM
reauth_confirm.description: The MySOLEM session for {email} expired. Please re-enter the password.

abort.already_configured: This MySOLEM account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials are for a different MySOLEM account than the one being re-authenticated.

set_enabled.name: Set enabled
set_enabled.description: Turns irrigation on, off permanently, or off for a number of days (rain delay).

days.name: Days
days.description: When turning off, how many days to stay off (rain delay). 0 or omitted means off permanently.

run.name: Run manual action
run.description: Stops watering, or starts a program or a station.

mode.name: Action
mode.description: What to do: stop, run a program, or run a station.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program to run (name or index). Required when the action is 'program'.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station to run (name or index). Required when the action is 'station'.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run time in minutes for a station. Defaults to the last used value; an explicit value is remembered for next time.

set_program_schedule.name: Set program schedule
set_program_schedule.description: Edits a stored program: its recurrence (days of the week, even or odd days, or every N days), its start times and station durations (classic controllers) or watering windows (LR-AG), its water budget, and whether it is on. The programs are backed up in MySOLEM first, saved there, then pushed to the controller.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program to edit (name, index or id).

schedule_type.name: Schedule type
schedule_type.description: Recurrence: weekly, even days, odd days, odd days except the 31st, or every N days (interval).

weekdays.name: Days of the week
weekdays.description: Days the program runs on (weekly schedule only).

every_days.name: Every N days
every_days.description: Days between two runs (interval schedule only, 1-31).

offset_days.name: Starting in
offset_days.description: Days from today until the first run (interval schedule only; less than the interval).

water_budget.name: Water budget
water_budget.description: Scales every duration (100% runs them as programmed).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the program on, or off (it stays stored but never runs).

start_times.name: Start times
start_times.description: Classic controllers: up to 8 HH:MM start times; the stations run one after the other from each.

durations.name: Station durations
durations.description: Classic controllers: minutes per station, keyed by station number (station 1 to 10 minutes: 1: 10). Stations left out keep their duration.

windows.name: Watering windows
windows.description: LR-AG: up to 4 windows, each with start, end and optional soak_on_minutes / soak_off_minutes; leave the soak fields out to water throughout.

push.name: Push to the controller
push.description: Push the change to the controller (after a short delay that groups several edits). Off saves it in MySOLEM only; push it later with the push programs action.

push_programs.name: Push programs
push_programs.description: Pushes the programs stored in MySOLEM to the controller now.

create_backup.name: Back up programs
create_backup.description: Saves a named backup of the controller's programs in MySOLEM, which can be restored from the MySOLEM app.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the backup (a timestamp if left out).
